candidate.description: Double-buffer K64 probability and V stages so idle waves prepare stage k+1 while active waves execute ordered PV for stage k.
candidate.control: retained mixed40 tail-producer schedule with two barriers per K64 stage

correctness.red: focused wrap/eviction test failed importing the absent double-buffer wrapper
correctness.green: focused wrap/eviction test passed after implementation

decision.reason: Seven fewer barriers do not repay the added LDS footprint and narrowed four-wave next-stage V loader; the exact leaf regresses 10.219%.
decision.retry_condition: Only revisit with a materially different loader or overlap mechanism that does not add a second full V stage in LDS.
